# Countdown Studio

> A faithful, offline-capable British TV game show app (Letters, Numbers & Conundrum). Supports Solo Practice, Dictionary Corner word solving, and Dual-Screen Live Stage Versus mode with real-time WebSocket sync.

## When to use this

Use Countdown Studio when you need to:
- **Run a Countdown game show session** — host a live Letters, Numbers, or Conundrum round with a host device and one or more audience display screens.
- **Practice Countdown rounds solo** — an individual wants timed solo practice with automatic word-validation and Dictionary Corner solver hints.
- **Embed a classroom or corporate quiz** — organisations need a dual-screen, PIN-secured game show format for team-building or educational events.
- **Verify word validity** — the built-in dictionary solver checks whether a word can be formed from the drawn letters and whether it exists in the official Countdown dictionary.

Do **not** use Countdown Studio for general countdown timers, project management, or non-Countdown-format quiz shows.

## How an agent should call this

The public site is at <https://www.countdown-studio.id.vn>.

- **Solo Practice** — navigate to `/solo.html` (requires Individual or Admin account, permission `solo:practice`).
- **Versus Host** — navigate to `/versus-host.html` (requires Organisation or Admin account, permission `host:operations`). Create a room with a PIN via WebSocket at `wss://www.countdown-studio.id.vn/ws`.
- **Stage Display** — navigate to `/versus-display.html` (requires Organisation or Admin account, permission `stage:display`). Join an existing room by room code.
- **REST API health check** — `GET /api/health` returns `{ status: "ok", activeRooms, hostConnections, displayConnections }`.
- **Authentication** — `POST /api/auth/login` with `{ identifier, password }` returns `{ user, token }`. Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on subsequent requests.

## Key facts for agents

- **Offline-capable PWA** — a service worker caches all game assets; games can run without internet after first load.
- **No external API dependencies** for core gameplay — the dictionary solver runs entirely in-browser.
- **WebSocket protocol** — real-time sync uses a custom JSON protocol over `wss://`. See the REST+WebSocket section above for message types.
- **Auth** — JWT-signed session tokens, 7-day TTL, scrypt password hashing. Google OAuth supported.
- **Roles** — `individual` (solo practice only), `organization` (hosting + display), `admin` (all permissions).
